title: The Arrears Charge Added Where a Storage Charge Stands Past Grace
content:
A charge standing past its grace period earns an arrears charge, and what is added turns on how the account has been kept. The arrears charge is added to the total drawn into the settlement on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The rule as posted

Where a charge stands past its grace period and the account carries a late charge raised within the last twelve months, the programme's late charge is added.

Where a charge stands past its grace period and no late charge has been raised on the account within the last twelve months, the programme's late charge is set aside for a member who has kept a clean twelve months and only the arrears notice fee of 15.00 is added.

And otherwise nothing is added.

## The programme's late charge

| Programme | Late charge (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 25.00 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 25.00 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 40.00 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 40.00 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 40.00 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 60.00 |

## The bands set out

| A charge stands past its grace period | A late charge raised on the account within the last twelve months | Added to the total |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the programme's late charge |
| yes | no | 15.00 |
| no | yes | nothing |
| no | no | nothing |

Where nothing stands past its grace period at all, the record of the last twelve months is beside the point and nothing is added.

## Worked figures, on hypothetical accounts

**A member on the Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage with a charge 9 days past grace and a late charge raised four months ago.** The programme's late charge of 40.00 is added.

**The same member with the same charge past grace, but with a clean twelve months behind them.** The arrears notice fee of 15.00 is added instead.

**A member on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage with nothing past its grace period.** Nothing is added, though that programme's late charge stands at 60.00 when one is due.
